type WorkflowSnapshot = Mapping[str, FrozenJsonValue]
type ReconstructedWorkflowState = Mapping[str, Mapping[str, str]]

def _record(value: object) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in value):
        return None
    candidate = cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)
    if any(key in _DANGEROUS_KEYS for key in candidate):
        return None
    return candidate


def _deep_equal(left: object, right: object) -> bool:
    return left == right and type(left) is type(right)


def _stable_json(value: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = cast(Mapping[str, object], value)
        return "{" + ",".join(f"{json.dumps(key)}:{_stable_json(candidate[key])}" for key in sorted(candidate)) + "}"
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        return "[" + ",".join(_stable_json(item) for item in value) + "]"
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("workflow contract contains a non-finite number")
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def _owned_frozen(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        candidate = _record(value)
        if candidate is None:
            raise ValueError("workflow object contains unsafe keys")
        if len(candidate) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("workflow object exceeds bound")
        return MappingProxyType({key: _owned_frozen(item) for key, item in candidate.items()})
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if len(value) > _MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS:
            raise ValueError("workflow collection exceeds bound")
        return tuple(_owned_frozen(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("workflow contract contains a non-finite number")
    return value


def _schema_record(value: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError("generated workflow schema is malformed")
    return cast(dict[str, Any], value)


def _resolve_reference(reference: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
    prefix = "#/$defs/"
    if not isinstance(reference, str) or not reference.startswith(prefix):
        raise ValueError("unsupported workflow schema reference")
    definitions = _schema_record(_WORKFLOW_SCHEMA["$defs"])
    return _schema_record(definitions[reference[len(prefix) :]])


def _type_matches(value: object, kind: object) -> bool:
    if kind == "null":
        return value is None
    if kind == "boolean":
        return isinstance(value, bool)
    if kind == "integer":
        return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and abs(value) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991
    if kind == "number":
        return isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value)
    if kind == "string":
        return isinstance(value, str)
    if kind == "array":
        return isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray)
    if kind == "object":
        return _record(value) is not None
    return False


def _validation_errors(value: object, node: dict[str, Any], path: str) -> list[str]:
    if "$ref" in node:
        return _validation_errors(value, _resolve_reference(node["$ref"]), path)
    errors: list[str] = []
    if "const" in node and not _deep_equal(value, node["const"]):
        errors.append(f"{path}: const")
    enum = node.get("enum")
    if isinstance(enum, list) and not any(_deep_equal(value, item) for item in enum):
        errors.append(f"{path}: enum")
    alternatives = node.get("oneOf")
    if isinstance(alternatives, list):
        matches = sum(not _validation_errors(value, _schema_record(item), path) for item in alternatives)
        if matches != 1:
            errors.append(f"{path}: alternatives")
    raw_types = node.get("type")
    types = raw_types if isinstance(raw_types, list) else [] if raw_types is None else [raw_types]
    if types and not any(_type_matches(value, kind) for kind in types):
        return [*errors, f"{path}: type"]
    if isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool) and math.isfinite(value):
        if isinstance(node.get("minimum"), int | float) and value < node["minimum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minimum")
        if isinstance(node.get("maximum"), int | float) and value > node["maximum"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maximum")
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if isinstance(node.get("minLength"), int) and len(value) < node["minLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxLength"), int) and len(value) > node["maxLength"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: maxLength")
        if isinstance(node.get("pattern"), str) and re.fullmatch(node["pattern"], value) is None:
            errors.append(f"{path}: pattern")
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        if isinstance(node.get("minItems"), int) and len(value) < node["minItems"]:
            errors.append(f"{path}: minItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("maxItems"), int) and len(value) > node["maxItems"]:
            return [*errors, f"{path}: maxItems"]
        if node.get("uniqueItems") is True and len({_stable_json(item) for item in value}) != len(value):
            errors.append(f"{path}: uniqueItems")
        if isinstance(node.get("items"), dict):
            for index, item in enumerate(value):
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(item, node["items"], f"{path}/{index}"))
    candidate = _record(value)
    if candidate is not None and ("object" in types or isinstance(node.get("properties"), dict)):
        required = node.get("required", [])
        if isinstance(required, list):
            for key in required:
                if isinstance(key, str) and key not in candidate:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: required")
        properties = node.get("properties", {})
        if not isinstance(properties, dict):
            raise ValueError("generated workflow schema properties are malformed")
        if node.get("additionalProperties") is False:
            for key in candidate:
                if key not in properties:
                    errors.append(f"{path}/{key}: additional property")
        for key, property_schema in properties.items():
            if key in candidate:
                errors.extend(_validation_errors(candidate[key], _schema_record(property_schema), f"{path}/{key}"))
    return errors


def _definition(name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _schema_record(_schema_record(_WORKFLOW_SCHEMA["$defs"])[name])


def _progress_errors(progress: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    kind = progress.get("kind")
    completed = progress.get("completedUnits")
    total = progress.get("totalUnits")
    if kind == "quantified":
        return not isinstance(completed, int) or not isinstance(total, int) or completed > total
    return completed is not None or total is not None


def _progress_definition_errors(progress: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return (progress.get("totalKind") == "known") != isinstance(progress.get("totalUnits"), int)


def _is_acyclic(steps: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    visiting: set[str] = set()
    visited: set[str] = set()

    def visit(key: str) -> bool:
        if key in visiting:
            return False
        if key in visited:
            return True
        visiting.add(key)
        for dependency in cast(Sequence[str], steps[key]["dependsOn"]):
            if dependency not in steps or not visit(dependency):
                return False
        visiting.remove(key)
        visited.add(key)
        return True

    return all(visit(key) for key in steps)


def workflow_definition_errors(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    try:
        structural = _validation_errors(value, _definition("WorkflowDefinition"), "$")
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("workflow-definition-structure-invalid",)
    if structural:
        return tuple(structural)
    definition = cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)
    steps = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], definition["steps"])
    errors: list[str] = []
    keys = [cast(str, step["stepKey"]) for step in steps]
    if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
        errors.append("definition-step-keys-are-unique")
    step_map = {cast(str, step["stepKey"]): step for step in steps}
    if len(step_map) != len(steps) or not _is_acyclic(step_map):
        errors.append("definition-dependencies-close-and-are-acyclic")
    for step in steps:
        is_activity = step["kind"] == "activity"
        if is_activity != isinstance(step["activityType"], str) or is_activity == (step["humanTask"] is not None):
            errors.append("step-shape-matches-kind")
        retry = cast(Mapping[str, Any], step["retryPolicy"])
        if retry["maximumBackoffMs"] < retry["initialBackoffMs"] or set(retry["retryableErrorCodes"]) & set(
            retry["nonRetryableErrorCodes"]
        ):
            errors.append("retry-policy-is-consistent")
        idempotency = cast(Mapping[str, Any], step["idempotency"])
        if (idempotency["mode"] == "required") != isinstance(idempotency["keyScope"], str):
            errors.append("idempotency-policy-is-consistent")
        checkpoint = cast(Mapping[str, Any], step["checkpointPolicy"])
        if (checkpoint["mode"] == "forbidden") != (checkpoint["maximumIntervalSeconds"] is None):
            errors.append("checkpoint-policy-is-consistent")
        if _progress_definition_errors(cast(Mapping[str, Any], step["progress"])):
            errors.append("progress-shape-is-consistent")
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))


def decode_workflow_definition(value: object) -> WorkflowSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if workflow_definition_errors(owned):
        return None
    return cast(WorkflowSnapshot, owned)


def workflow_transition_allowed(entity_type: str, from_state: str | None, to_state: str) -> bool:
    entity = _TRANSITIONS.get(entity_type)
    return entity is not None and to_state in entity.get(from_state, frozenset())


def _collection_map(snapshot: Mapping[str, Any], collection: str, identity: str) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]:
    return {cast(str, item[identity]): item for item in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot[collection])}


def _reconstruct(
    snapshot: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, str]], dict[tuple[str, str], int], list[str]]:
    state: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {kind: {} for kind in _TRANSITIONS}
    latest: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    errors: list[str] = []
    progress_by_attempt: dict[str, tuple[str, int | None, int | None]] = {}
    security_locked = False
    history = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["history"])
    for index, event in enumerate(history, start=1):
        if event["sequence"] != index:
            errors.append("history-sequence-is-contiguous")
        kind = cast(str, event["entityType"])
        identity = cast(str, event["entityId"])
        prior = state.get(kind, {}).get(identity)
        if event["fromState"] != prior or not workflow_transition_allowed(kind, prior, cast(str, event["toState"])):
            errors.append("history-transition-is-allowed")
        else:
            state[kind][identity] = cast(str, event["toState"])
        latest[(kind, identity)] = cast(int, event["sequence"])
        progress = _record(event["progress"])
        if kind == "job-attempt" and progress is not None:
            if _progress_errors(progress):
                errors.append("progress-shape-is-consistent")
            current = (
                cast(str, progress["kind"]),
                cast(int | None, progress["completedUnits"]),
                cast(int | None, progress["totalUnits"]),
            )
            previous = progress_by_attempt.get(identity)
            if previous is not None and (
                previous[0] != current[0]
                or previous[2] != current[2]
                or (isinstance(previous[1], int) and isinstance(current[1], int) and current[1] < previous[1])
            ):
                errors.append("attempt-progress-is-monotonic")
            progress_by_attempt[identity] = current
        if event["interruptionKind"] == "security-lock":
            security_locked = True
        elif security_locked and kind == "workflow-run" and event["toState"] in {"running", "succeeded"}:
            errors.append("security-lock-does-not-auto-resume")
    if snapshot["sequence"] != len(history):
        errors.append("history-sequence-is-contiguous")
    return state, latest, errors


def _reference_errors(definition: Mapping[str, Any], snapshot: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    errors: list[str] = []
    step_runs = _collection_map(snapshot, "stepRuns", "stepRunId")
    jobs = _collection_map(snapshot, "jobs", "jobId")
    attempts = _collection_map(snapshot, "attempts", "attemptId")
    checkpoints = _collection_map(snapshot, "checkpoints", "checkpointId")
    artifacts = _collection_map(snapshot, "artifacts", "artifactId")
    human_tasks = _collection_map(snapshot, "humanTasks", "humanTaskId")
    definition_steps = {step["stepKey"]: step for step in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], definition["steps"])}
    if (
        len(step_runs) != len(snapshot["stepRuns"])
        or len(jobs) != len(snapshot["jobs"])
        or len(attempts) != len(snapshot["attempts"])
        or len(checkpoints) != len(snapshot["checkpoints"])
        or len(artifacts) != len(snapshot["artifacts"])
        or len(human_tasks) != len(snapshot["humanTasks"])
    ):
        errors.append("identities-are-unique")
    if set(step["stepKey"] for step in step_runs.values()) != set(definition_steps):
        errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
    for step in step_runs.values():
        if any(job_id not in jobs or jobs[job_id]["stepRunId"] != step["stepRunId"] for job_id in step["jobIds"]):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if any(
            task_id not in human_tasks or human_tasks[task_id]["stepRunId"] != step["stepRunId"]
            for task_id in step["humanTaskIds"]
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if any(artifact_id not in artifacts for artifact_id in (*step["inputArtifactIds"], *step["outputArtifactIds"])):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        defined = definition_steps.get(step["stepKey"])
        if defined is not None and ((defined["kind"] == "human-task") != bool(step["humanTaskIds"])):
            errors.append("step-shape-matches-kind")
    for job in jobs.values():
        if job["stepRunId"] not in step_runs or job["jobId"] not in step_runs.get(job["stepRunId"], {}).get(
            "jobIds", ()
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if any(
            attempt_id not in attempts or attempts[attempt_id]["jobId"] != job["jobId"]
            for attempt_id in job["attemptIds"]
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if job["currentAttemptId"] is not None and job["currentAttemptId"] not in job["attemptIds"]:
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if any(artifact_id not in artifacts for artifact_id in (*job["inputArtifactIds"], *job["outputArtifactIds"])):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
    for attempt in attempts.values():
        if attempt["jobId"] not in jobs or attempt["attemptId"] not in jobs.get(attempt["jobId"], {}).get(
            "attemptIds", ()
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if any(
            checkpoint_id not in checkpoints or checkpoints[checkpoint_id]["attemptId"] != attempt["attemptId"]
            for checkpoint_id in attempt["checkpointIds"]
        ):
            errors.append("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent")
        if any(
            artifact_id not in artifacts or artifacts[artifact_id]["createdByAttemptId"] != attempt["attemptId"]
            for artifact_id in attempt["outputArtifactIds"]
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
        if attempt["state"] != "succeeded" and attempt["outputArtifactIds"]:
            errors.append("unsuccessful-attempt-has-no-accepted-output")
    checkpoint_by_attempt: dict[str, list[Mapping[str, Any]]] = {}
    for checkpoint in checkpoints.values():
        checkpoint_by_attempt.setdefault(cast(str, checkpoint["attemptId"]), []).append(checkpoint)
        payload = artifacts.get(cast(str, checkpoint["payloadArtifactId"]))
        if (
            checkpoint["attemptId"] not in attempts
            or payload is None
            or payload["role"] != "checkpoint"
            or payload["createdByAttemptId"] != checkpoint["attemptId"]
        ):
            errors.append("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent")
    for items in checkpoint_by_attempt.values():
        ordered = sorted(items, key=lambda item: cast(int, item["checkpointSequence"]))
        if [item["checkpointSequence"] for item in ordered] != list(range(1, len(ordered) + 1)) or any(
            ordered[index]["historySequence"] >= ordered[index + 1]["historySequence"]
            for index in range(len(ordered) - 1)
        ):
            errors.append("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent")
    for artifact in artifacts.values():
        if artifact["createdByAttemptId"] is not None and artifact["createdByAttemptId"] not in attempts:
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
    for task in human_tasks.values():
        task_step = step_runs.get(cast(str, task["stepRunId"]))
        defined = definition_steps.get(task_step["stepKey"]) if task_step is not None else None
        if (
            task["workflowRunId"] != snapshot["workflowRunId"]
            or task["definitionRevisionId"] != definition["definitionRevisionId"]
            or task_step is None
            or task["humanTaskId"] not in task_step["humanTaskIds"]
            or defined is None
            or defined["kind"] != "human-task"
            or task["requiredRole"] != cast(Mapping[str, Any], defined["humanTask"])["requiredRole"]
            or any(artifact_id not in artifacts for artifact_id in task["evidenceArtifactIds"])
        ):
            errors.append("references-close-over-snapshot")
    return errors


def workflow_snapshot_errors(definition_value: object, value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if workflow_definition_errors(definition_value):
        return ("workflow-snapshot-definition-invalid",)
    try:
        structural = _validation_errors(value, _definition("WorkflowSnapshot"), "$")
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("workflow-snapshot-structure-invalid",)
    if structural:
        return tuple(structural)
    definition = cast(Mapping[str, Any], definition_value)
    snapshot = cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)
    errors: list[str] = []
    reference = cast(Mapping[str, Any], snapshot["definition"])
    if (
        reference["workflowDefinitionId"] != definition["workflowDefinitionId"]
        or reference["definitionRevisionId"] != definition["definitionRevisionId"]
        or reference["definitionVersion"] != definition["definitionVersion"]
        or reference["contentHash"] != workflow_record_sha256(definition)
    ):
        errors.append("snapshot-binds-exact-definition")
    if _progress_errors(cast(Mapping[str, Any], snapshot["progress"])) or any(
        _progress_errors(cast(Mapping[str, Any], item["progress"]))
        for collection in ("stepRuns", "attempts")
        for item in cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot[collection])
    ):
        errors.append("progress-shape-is-consistent")
    cancellation = cast(Mapping[str, Any], snapshot["cancellation"])
    if (cancellation["requestedAt"] is None) != (cancellation["reasonCode"] is None) or (
        cancellation["requestedAt"] is None
    ) != (cancellation["interruptionKind"] is None):
        errors.append("cancellation-shape-is-consistent")
    errors.extend(_reference_errors(definition, snapshot))
    state, latest, history_errors = _reconstruct(snapshot)
    errors.extend(history_errors)
    projection_inventory: tuple[tuple[str, str, str, Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]], ...] = (
        ("workflow-step", "stepRunId", "stepRuns", cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["stepRuns"])),
        ("job", "jobId", "jobs", cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["jobs"])),
        ("job-attempt", "attemptId", "attempts", cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["attempts"])),
        ("human-task", "humanTaskId", "humanTasks", cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["humanTasks"])),
    )
    if state["workflow-run"].get(cast(str, snapshot["workflowRunId"])) != snapshot["state"]:
        errors.append("history-reconstructs-current-state")
    for kind, identity_key, _collection, items in projection_inventory:
        for item in items:
            identity = cast(str, item[identity_key])
            if state[kind].get(identity) != item["state"] or latest.get((kind, identity)) != item["sequence"]:
                errors.append("history-reconstructs-current-state")
    history = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["history"])
    checkpoints = _collection_map(snapshot, "checkpoints", "checkpointId")
    for checkpoint in checkpoints.values():
        if not any(
            event["sequence"] == checkpoint["historySequence"]
            and event["entityType"] == "job-attempt"
            and event["entityId"] == checkpoint["attemptId"]
            and event["checkpointId"] == checkpoint["checkpointId"]
            for event in history
        ):
            errors.append("checkpoint-order-and-owner-are-consistent")
    jobs = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["jobs"])
    attempts = _collection_map(snapshot, "attempts", "attemptId")
    artifacts = _collection_map(snapshot, "artifacts", "artifactId")
    idempotency: dict[str, str] = {}
    for job in jobs:
        prior = idempotency.setdefault(cast(str, job["idempotencyKey"]), cast(str, job["commandFingerprint"]))
        if prior != job["commandFingerprint"]:
            errors.append("job-idempotency-binds-command-fingerprint")
        job_attempts = [attempts[attempt_id] for attempt_id in job["attemptIds"] if attempt_id in attempts]
        if sorted(attempt["attemptNumber"] for attempt in job_attempts) != list(range(1, len(job_attempts) + 1)):
            errors.append("attempt-numbers-are-contiguous")
        succeeded = [attempt for attempt in job_attempts if attempt["state"] == "succeeded"]
        if len(succeeded) > 1:
            errors.append("job-has-at-most-one-succeeded-attempt")
        if job["state"] == "succeeded" and (
            len(succeeded) != 1
            or job["currentAttemptId"] != succeeded[0]["attemptId"]
            or set(job["outputArtifactIds"]) != set(succeeded[0]["outputArtifactIds"])
            or any(
                artifacts[artifact_id]["disposition"] != "committed"
                for artifact_id in job["outputArtifactIds"]
                if artifact_id in artifacts
            )
        ):
            errors.append("succeeded-output-artifacts-are-committed")
    human_tasks = cast(Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], snapshot["humanTasks"])
    for task in human_tasks:
        decision = _record(task["decision"])
        if (task["state"] == "completed") != (decision is not None):
            errors.append("completed-human-task-binds-decision")
        if decision is not None:
            completion = [
                event
                for event in history
                if event["entityType"] == "human-task"
                and event["entityId"] == task["humanTaskId"]
                and event["toState"] == "completed"
            ]
            assigned = _record(task["assignedTo"])
            actor = _record(completion[0]["actor"]) if len(completion) == 1 else None
            if (
                len(completion) != 1
                or completion[0]["decisionId"] != decision["decisionId"]
                or actor is None
                or actor != decision["decidedBy"]
                or assigned is None
                or assigned != decision["decidedBy"]
                or decision["decidedBy"]["actorType"] != "human"
                or decision["decidedBy"]["role"] != task["requiredRole"]
                or decision["decidedAt"] != completion[0]["occurredAt"]
                or any(artifact_id not in artifacts for artifact_id in decision["evidenceArtifactIds"])
                or (decision["rationaleArtifactId"] is not None and decision["rationaleArtifactId"] not in artifacts)
            ):
                errors.append("human-decision-is-audit-bound")
    if cancellation["interruptionKind"] == "security-lock" and snapshot["state"] not in {
        "cancelling",
        "cancelled",
        "failed",
    }:
        errors.append("security-lock-does-not-auto-resume")
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(errors))


def decode_workflow_snapshot(definition: object, value: object) -> WorkflowSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if workflow_snapshot_errors(definition, owned):
        return None
    return cast(WorkflowSnapshot, owned)


def reconstruct_workflow_state(definition: object, value: object) -> ReconstructedWorkflowState:
    if workflow_snapshot_errors(definition, value):
        raise ValueError("invalid workflow snapshot")
    state, _latest, _errors = _reconstruct(cast(Mapping[str, Any], value))
    return MappingProxyType({kind: MappingProxyType(dict(values)) for kind, values in state.items()})


def legacy_operation_bridge_errors(snapshot_value: object, value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    try:
        structural = _validation_errors(value, _definition("LegacyOperationBridge"), "$")
    except KeyError, TypeError, ValueError:
        return ("legacy-operation-bridge-structure-invalid",)
    if structural:
        return tuple(structural)
    snapshot = _record(snapshot_value)
    bridge = cast(Mapping[str, Any], value)
    if snapshot is None or snapshot.get("documentType") != "research-observatory-workflow-snapshot":
        return ("legacy-operation-bridge-snapshot-invalid",)
    mapped = {
        "accepted": "queued",
        "running": "running",
        "waiting-human": "running",
        "paused": "running",
        "cancelling": "running",
        "succeeded": "succeeded",
        "failed": "failed",
        "cancelled": "cancelled",
    }.get(cast(str, snapshot.get("state")))
    cancellation = _record(snapshot.get("cancellation"))
    errors: list[str] = []
    if (
        bridge["workflowRunId"] != snapshot.get("workflowRunId")
        or bridge["workflowSnapshotRevision"] != snapshot.get("snapshotRevision")
        or bridge["operationState"] != mapped
        or bridge["cancellationRequested"] != (cancellation is not None and cancellation.get("requestedAt") is not None)
    ):
        errors.append("legacy-operation-bridge-binds-exact-workflow-projection")
    if bridge["etag"] != f'"{bridge["legacyOperationId"]}-{bridge["operationSequence"]}"':
        errors.append("legacy-operation-bridge-etag-is-exact")
    return tuple(errors)


def decode_legacy_operation_bridge(snapshot: object, value: object) -> WorkflowSnapshot | None:
    try:
        owned = _owned_frozen(value)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if legacy_operation_bridge_errors(snapshot, owned):
        return None
    return cast(WorkflowSnapshot, owned)


def canonical_workflow_json(value: object) -> str:
    candidate = _record(value)
    if candidate is None or candidate.get("documentType") not in {
        "research-observatory-workflow-definition",
        "research-observatory-workflow-snapshot",
        "research-observatory-legacy-operation-bridge",
    }:
        raise ValueError("invalid workflow contract document")
    return _stable_json(value)


def workflow_record_sha256(value: object) -> str:
    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(canonical_workflow_json(value).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}"
